P2.fix: Sources/ProxyKernel/Support/RotatingLogFile.swift write(_:): queue.async { drainPending() } moved inside admission.withLockedValue, on the branch that sets draining and enters the group. Enqueue only: no callback, I/O or publication under the lock; the drain block takes the lock itself later on the queue. The schedule Bool is gone. close() is unchanged: latch under the same lock, then queue.sync. FIFO on the one serial queue now puts every admitted record's drain ahead of close's join. No new queue, capacity, registry or retirement path.
P2.retained_test: Tests/ConduitTests/RotatingLogFileProtectionTests.swift testConcurrentWritesAndCloseAccountForEveryRecord. Eight paced writer threads; close at the first observed moment, within a bounded 200 ms, when admitted records are pending and none are being written, else close anyway; 50 more writes per thread after close. Asserts: pending == 0 when close returns; after the join failed == 0, written unchanged since close, written + dropped == attempts, dropped >= 400, the file's line count == written. It is a concurrent custody invariant under stress and does not force any interleaving.

temporary_control.patch: In write(_:), between the unlock and the old out-of-lock enqueue: `if schedule { usleep(20_000) }` (a widened window). In close(), after queue.sync: read (pendingRecords, draining) under the lock and print `TEMP-CONTROL close returned with pending=N draining=B` to stderr when N > 0 (a positive causal fact).
